verdict.reason: The source reports varied calibration, from near-perfect (Claude Opus, ECE 0.05) to severely overconfident (Gemma 3-12B), not poor calibration across models. Qwen3-VL-235B's AUROC of 0.62 is accurate but AUROC measures discrimination, not calibration. It is also not the worst: Gemma 3-12B verbalized has 0.58.
